verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS monitoring platform like Sentry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of an interactive API reference or runnable examples. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. The llms.txt file and the official CLI are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
